# CodexMeter 2.0.7
Limit readings that say the truth once, and a Settings window that opens.
## What changed
- **The same limit is no longer drawn twice.** Every window of a provider shared one identifier, so the notch tooltip rendered the first one once per duplicate — the "Weekly / Weekly" and "5 hours / 5 hours" pairs, identical down to the reset time. - **Two limit groups no longer share a label.** Codex meters a per-model allowance beside the plan's own and both printed as "5 hours"; a row now names its group when there is more than one. - **ChatGPT Pro's phantom five hours is gone.** Pro has only the weekly allowance, but the app-server reports a five-hour window anyway — with a reset that is not five hours away. Hidden for Pro accounts and nobody else. - **Settings opens.** An accessory app is restricted from activating its own windows, so "Settings…" could look like it did nothing. It now comes forward reliably, and re-centres if it was left on a display that is gone. - **The notch is on by default.** A first launch showing nothing but a status-bar glyph does not look like a working app. - **Settings rebuilt** — tinted icon badges in the sidebar, panes made of grouped rounded cards, in the shape macOS System Settings uses. The settings search field is gone.
## Verification
- 598 automated tests, 0 failures (9 environment-integration tests skipped). - `swift build` with zero warnings and zero errors. - Universal 2 build for Apple silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14 or later. - Ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized. SHA-256 protects the first download; Sparkle authenticates later updates with Ed25519 signatures.
## Install or update with Homebrew
```bash brew update brew upgrade --cask --greedy dlfkdLR/tap/codexmeter ```
```bash xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
## First direct-download launch
Download `CodexMeter-2.0.7.dmg` and `SHA256SUMS.txt` into the same folder and verify the checksum before opening:
```bash cd ~/Downloads grep ' CodexMeter-2.0.7.dmg$' SHA256SUMS.txt | shasum -a 256 -c - open CodexMeter-2.0.7.dmg ```
## Recovery
This release does not migrate any database. Published version tags are immutable; corrections ship as a new patch release.
